title: Customer Complaint Triage and Routing
summary: Classify complaints from email, branches, social media and RBI CMS, spot urgent cases such as unauthorised transactions, route them to resolver teams and draft acknowledgements.

seo.title: Bank Complaint Triage and Routing with AI | VipraTech
seo.description: AI that classifies bank complaints from every channel, flags unauthorised-transaction and repeat cases, routes them to resolver teams and tracks timelines.

problem.intro: Complaints reach a bank through branch letters, emails, the contact centre, social media, the website and RBI's Complaint Management System. Each must be logged, categorised, routed and resolved within internal and regulatory timelines, and a misrouted complaint can sit for days before anyone notices.

pain_points.title: Free text that resists categories
pain_points.detail: Customers describe a failed UPI transfer, a disputed card charge and a recovery agent's call in one message, often in Hinglish, so manual tagging is inconsistent.

pain_points.title: Urgent cases buried in volume
pain_points.detail: Reports of unauthorised electronic transactions, fraud or harassment need fast action under RBI's customer liability rules, but arrive mixed with routine requests.

pain_points.title: Repeat and escalating complainants
pain_points.detail: The same customer writes through several channels, and mentions of the Ombudsman, legal action or social media go unnoticed until escalation happens.

pain_points.title: Weak root-cause visibility
pain_points.detail: Management reports count complaints by broad category, so the product or process faults behind them stay hidden.

solution.overview: We build a triage service that reads every incoming complaint, whatever the channel or language, and turns it into a structured case. A language model identifies the product, the issue, transaction references and the outcome the customer wants, then maps the case to your complaint taxonomy and to RBI reporting categories. Rules mark urgent signals such as unauthorised debits, fraud reports and recovery-agent harassment, and link duplicates across channels. The case goes to the resolver team with a drafted acknowledgement and a timeline clock. Before a complaint is partly or wholly rejected, the system prepares the file for internal ombudsman review as your process requires.
capabilities: Reads emails, scanned letters, web forms, social posts and call notes in English, Hindi, Hinglish and regional languages
Extracts account, card, UPI and transaction references and the resolution the customer asks for
Maps each case to the bank's taxonomy and to RBI complaint categories
Flags unauthorised transactions, fraud reports, recovery-agent conduct and escalation language
Links duplicate and repeat complaints across channels into one case history
Drafts acknowledgements and response letters for officer approval

workflow.title: Collect complaints
workflow.detail: Connectors pull complaints from email, the CRM, branch scans, social listening tools and RBI CMS exports into one intake queue.

workflow.title: Understand the complaint
workflow.detail: The model extracts product, issue, references, sentiment and the requested outcome, with card, account and Aadhaar numbers masked.

workflow.title: Classify and prioritise
workflow.detail: Cases are mapped to the taxonomy, urgent signals raise priority and duplicates are linked to existing cases.

workflow.title: Check confidence
workflow.detail: Low-confidence classifications go to a triage officer instead of being routed automatically.

workflow.title: Route and acknowledge
workflow.detail: The case reaches the resolver team with a drafted acknowledgement and a timeline based on its category.

workflow.title: Track and report
workflow.detail: Ageing, breaches, rejections due for internal ombudsman review and root-cause themes appear in daily dashboards.

inputs: Complaint emails and web form submissions
Social media mentions from the bank's listening tool
Complaint taxonomy, routing matrix and timeline rules
outputs: Structured case with product, issue, references and requested outcome
Priority and urgency flags with reasons
human_in_the_loop: Triage officers confirm low-confidence classifications, and resolver teams own every response and closure. No complaint is rejected without a person's decision, and rejections follow the bank's internal ombudsman process.
integrations: Complaint management system or CRM, such as Salesforce or an in-house tool
Core banking and card systems for read-only reference lookups
guardrails: Card, account and Aadhaar numbers masked before model processing
Urgent categories always routed to people, with no automatic reply beyond acknowledgement
Drafted responses require officer approval before sending
Taxonomy mapping reviewed weekly against officer corrections
Drafts never promise refunds, compensation or outcomes
compliance_notes: Designed to support complaint handling under RBI's grievance redressal expectations and the Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021.
Supports timely handling of unauthorised electronic transaction complaints under RBI's customer liability framework.

pilot.scope: Email and web-form complaints for two products, such as debit cards and UPI, classified in shadow mode alongside your current triage team.
deliverables: Taxonomy and routing matrix configured for the pilot products
Working triage service on historical and live shadow complaints
Production plan covering more channels and products

what_we_measure.how: Model category compared with the category assigned by experienced triage officers for the same complaints.
Officer review of whether fraud, unauthorised transaction and harassment cases were flagged.
Cases reassigned by resolver teams after initial routing, tracked during shadow mode.
Drafted acknowledgements approved as written, with minor edits or rewritten.

faqs.q: Can it read complaints written in Hinglish or regional languages?
faqs.a: Yes. The extractor handles English, Hindi, Hinglish and major Indian languages, and keeps the original text beside a working translation so officers can check the meaning. Low-confidence cases go to a person.
Only after an officer approves them. The system drafts acknowledgements and responses, and your team edits and sends them through your existing channels.

faqs.q: Can it map to RBI reporting categories?
faqs.a: Yes. Each case carries both your internal taxonomy code and the RBI category used in your complaint reporting, and your team maintains the mapping table.

faqs.q: What about complaints already in RBI CMS?
faqs.a: We ingest CMS exports or your existing download of those complaints, so they appear in the same queue and history as other channels. Responses to RBI continue through the channels your Principal Nodal Officer uses today.
